title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP09 — base validation compatibility bridge
goal: Teach base-owned validators to verify both the current layout and the exact future CP09 layout before authorizing the migration.
acceptanceCriteria: The manifest checker selects exactly one canonical layout from guard-system docsMap presence and validates docs-map only in the future layout.
Manifest, tools, and trusted-base tests pass on the current layout and exercise the future commands/evidence behavior when those exact surfaces exist.
Trusted candidate validation proves unchanged gate verdicts and no reduction in negative-control coverage.
